scope: Primary-source overlap check for candidate31; not exhaustive originality verification

papers.title: BayesOD: A Bayesian Approach for Uncertainty Estimation in Deep Object Detectors
papers.metadata_source: Paper Search arXiv and downloaded PDF first page
read_sections: II.B uncertainty estimation and related clustering
III.A per-anchor Gaussian posterior and covariance
papers.overlap: Box uncertainty, full within-box covariance, spatial clustering and posterior box fusion are established.
papers.distinction: BayesOD III.C explicitly uses conditional independence between cluster observations. Candidate31 estimates pooled cross-SOURCE uncentered error inner products, not a probabilistic within-box covariance or BayesOD reproduction. This distinction alone does not establish novelty.

other_established_priors: Weighted Boxes Fusion and variance voting already archived. Generalized least-squares and nonnegative quadratic fusion are classical estimation, not claimed original.
current_claim: Candidate31 has small diagnostic improvements over uniform/diagonal/equal voting but loses to ordinary confidence voting and regret; no effective innovative method is established.
